turns.reply: The anyOf list now stays at 2 entries across all three routes, and the existing OpenAPI examples tests pass.

The fix is in `fastapi/openapi/utils.py`: app-level `responses` entries are now deep-copied (minus `model`) instead of shallow-copied, so the shared `content` dict is no longer mutated across routes. With a `Union` model and examples, `anyOf` stays at 2 entries for each of three routes instead of growing, and `tests/test_openapi_examples.py` passes. I did not run the wider OpenAPI test suite.
